title: Boom Box
description: A pocket radio pushed through every PBR channel that matters: chipped enamel, a woven speaker grille, and a handle that still reads as painted metal.

title: Iridescence Lamp
description: A cloth shade with a foil interior that throws green and magenta, sitting on a glass sphere. The color lives in the rim.
notes: CC BY 4.0. Wayfair. The Bonsell table lamp.

title: Sheen Chair
description: Tufted velvet on a wood frame. The cloth lights up at a glance and goes quiet when you face it straight on.
notes: CC BY 4.0. Eric Chadwick for Wayfair.

title: Water Bottle
description: A brushed metal bottle in a matte cage, with a soft red cap. The metal takes a broad highlight; the cage stays quiet.

title: Velvet Sofa
description: A curved sofa in deep blue velvet. Specular color lets the fabric stain the reflection instead of throwing a white highlight.
notes: CC BY 4.0. Wayfair. Frankie sofa bed.

title: Avocado
description: Skin, flesh, and the pit. A small mesh with a loud normal map — the pebble of the rind is the whole study.

title: Carbon Fibre
description: A weave swatch. Anisotropy should pull the highlight along the fiber. Rotate it and watch the sheen follow the cloth.
notes: CC BY 4.0. Eric Chadwick for Wayfair.

title: Fox
description: A low-poly fox with a walk cycle. Flat color, a hard silhouette, and just enough texture to read as fur from across the room.
notes: Mesh CC0, PixelMannen. Rig and walk CC BY 4.0, tomkranis.

title: Milk Truck
description: Cesium’s milk truck, kept small on purpose. Painted panels, a simple cabin, and a silhouette that still reads at thumbnail size.
